description: The agent dials the number, works the menu, hold and any bot until a real person answers, then rings your person's mobile and connects them. Spends credits ($0.30/min). If it hits voicemail it leaves a short message with a callback (default on; voicemail: skip to turn off).

callback.description: Number to leave: 'crew_line' (the agent's line, default), 'me', or a number.

target.description: Who to ask for: a name or a role (the pharmacy, the front desk).

why.description: One line on what it's about.

name: call
title: Get me a human
